decisions.reason: The revised Payment and Milestone Schedule changes a table-specific artifact but does not change the narrative content, section order, or Section 2 requirement.
Adding rows to the Payment and Milestone Schedule does not change the cover letter's page count, signature, or image-relocation requirements.
The table revision does not alter any photo selection, placement, or cropping requirement.
The source changes the contents of one supplied table, while the general document layout and graphic-treatment requirements remain valid unchanged.
The revised schedule table does not change the Agua Arc identity or brand assets applied to the proposal.
The table-content revision does not change the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the saved proposal.
Adding rows to a proposal table does not modify the required PDF format, file count, email submission method, or export quality.
Supplying a revised table through the Google document does not change Canva access, ownership, editability, or asset-policy requirements.
The client requests incorporation of a revised table but does not change any draft, revision, or submission deadline.
Although additional rows may affect document length during implementation, the source does not change the applicable page-limit goal or reduction approach.
The revised table is an item to address during the existing revision round and does not change the number of rounds or the established revision trigger.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and has no effect on the TPEC proposal-design requirement.
